source.note: semantic-face v20, the last of twenty face-projection iterations. The rig is a clean 86-bone UE5 Manny export; the outstanding problem is the face texture, not the skeleton. The face is carried by a SEPARATE material projected onto the head, which is the mechanism behind the stamped-face rejection recorded in HANDOFF.md.

normalize.target_height_reason: Measured 2.000 m with feet already on Z=0, matching field-scout-male. No rescale applied.

budget_waiver.reason: Dense generated-and-repaired topology inherited from the legacy studio. Retopology to the 20k budget is scheduled work, not a blocker for engine validation. Deformation is correct at 4 influences with zero unweighted vertices.

texture_waiver.reason: Textures are inherited from the legacy back-projection stage, which used a per-patch xatlas layout and baked its lighting into the albedo. Regenerating them is scheduled work; the measured numbers are recorded here so the debt stays visible rather than silently passing.
